label: Shure AD610 (Ad Showlink Access Point, L/Ps43)

_avail.note: PoE class 1 - class maximum 3.84 W used; alt. 15 V DC external PSU. Price list net weight 1.157 kg differs from datasheet weight (datasheet value used).
_avail.portsMissing: Unit-side Ethernet connector type is not named (etherCON inferred from the furnished RJ45-to-etherCON cable).
_avail.notes: weightKg was 0.5 before the data sheet (shure/AD610-user-guide.pdf, 2026-11-27); datasheetUrl was https://content-files.shure.com/Pubs/adx2fd-sm58/axient-digital-specification-sheet-letter-en.pdf (lacks connector counts / types; replaced by the official user guide)

ports.label: Antenna A
ports.notes: SMA, 50 ohm; detachable 2.4 GHz omni antenna (or AXT644 patch)

ports.label: Antenna B
ports.notes: SMA, 50 ohm; detachable 2.4 GHz omni antenna (true diversity)

ports.label: ShowLink (Wireless)
ports.notes: Wireless link: ShowLink IEEE 802.15.4, 2.40-2.4835 GHz, up to 24 Axient / Axient Digital transmitters

ports.label: LAN (PoE)
ports.notes: Ethernet 10/100; powered by PoE Class 1 (36-57 V); furnished cable is RJ45-to-etherCON

ports.label: DC Power In
ports.notes: Optional external supply PS43, 15 V DC 600 mA, locking ring; use when PoE is not available
